G3_faithfulness.justification: Because exactly k components are selected and every coordinate lies in 1..k, product diversity k³ is equivalent to using every value exactly once in all three coordinates, matching the original task.

G4_naturalness.justification: The alloy framing is somewhat contrived for a three-dimensional matching task but remains clear and idiomatic overall.
